correctness.rationale: The 18 incidence vertices, 1,444 nonempty faces and five face counts are exactly reconstructed by two independent algorithms. The 708-pair matching has a complete, acyclic 5,388-arrow Hasse orientation and leaves precisely one critical 0-cell and 27 critical 4-cells. Forman’s theorem gives the integral wedge; binary boundary ranks and exact Laplacian determinant are independent checks.

value.rationale: The 3-sun is the canonical six-vertex sun graph and natural obstruction in strong-chordality theory. Its integral rooted-forest topology is an exact natural invariant not settled by known source/dominant-pair/multipartite shellability formulas. A sphere-wedge classification is stronger than its already implied Euler characteristic and supplies a base case for broader sun-graph topology without claiming such an extension.
